paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.51% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.18%) and FTSE 100 weakest (-0.75%). Brent crude changed -2.61% to 110.91. Gold changed -0.61% to 4,049.7. Bitcoin changed +1.06% to 80,850.9375. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.993%, a relative move of +0.14%. Among the firms tracked, HSBC (-5.70%) and BHP (+4.39%) moved the most.
